scope: Catalog column descriptor layout, CPersonData cross-check, entry state, and selection-result submission

evidence.descriptor: Generic header and row builders consume byte +0x08 as preferred 8-pixel cell width and byte +0x09 as left/right/center alignment; key and header message ID occupy the first two dwords
evidence.cross_domain: 50 tactic, 56 fixed-building, and 187 person descriptors all use the same 12-byte triple layout; all 293 reserved high words are zero
evidence.person_catalog: The 850-capacity dialog is constructed and consumed through CPersonData lists and runtime-class checks; its item vtable descriptor provider covers keys 0..186
evidence.entry_state: Bit 0 is synthesized from the container current index, bit 1 is stored selection, bit 2 is stored disablement, and selector 4 means all entries rather than a state bit
evidence.submission: Command 7501 closes through the accept virtual without copying a result; callers inspect modal result 1 and then collect selector-1 entries, while result 2 follows cancel handling

function_recovery.note: Recovered CPersonData descriptor provider from item-vtable reference and validated code boundary
Recovered common accept path from all 17 specialized catalog vtables
Recovered adjacent common cancel path from all 17 specialized catalog vtables

ida_changes.read_back: All ten names, the 12-byte descriptor type, three domain descriptor signatures, person descriptor access, entry-state collection, and accept path were visible after save

conclusion: Column metadata, value formatting, and entry state are separate protocols. Accepted modal dialogs retain selection in the entry container; callers explicitly extract selected domain objects after result code 1.
